decisions.text:
Decisions in this design

• The page speaks as the studio: what we design, build and keep running. The founder belongs on the founder page, not in front of the work.
• The hero names the four engagements — Product Blueprint, Launch Sprint, Operations Platform, Product Care — so a first-time visitor sees the shape of the offer before the studies.
• The hero is 420px so the first study is almost on screen at load, over a darkened crop of the homepage's own tree photograph.
• Filters show only the categories that actually exist. Today that is All work and Client work; the rest appear as studies are published.
• The single published study is a wide card, not one of a grid of one. Once there are more, it stays the lead card and the others sit in a two-column grid below.
• Classification and production status are chips on the card, so the label is read before the title.
• Evidence is stated on the card, not only inside the study: verified privately, with the date.
• The closing call asks for a project review rather than repeating the homepage's "start a conversation", because the page's own point is that the rest is private.

Motion
• Hero: eyebrow, headline and lead rise in; a warm light drifts behind
• Cards lift slightly on hover and the arrow steps right
• Everything stops under reduce-motion

guide.text:
How to use this blueprint

This canvas is the design for /work. The homepage has its own canvas; this one covers only the work page and the case-study cards on it.

To change something, name the section and the change, e.g. "In 2 · Published studies, put the role above the title." Edit a section board on the right and the full desktop page follows. The phone board is separate: mention it when a change should reach phones too.

What is real and what is a placeholder
• The one card with a title is the real published study (loyalty and operations platform), taken from the site's own records
• [STUDY TITLE] and the dashed cards are placeholders for studies not yet written
• The board at the bottom shows the same page once five studies exist; it is a future state, not the live page

Where things live in the code
• Case study facts, classification, status, evidence: src/lib/content.ts
• Which studies appear publicly: the permission and evidence gate at the end of that file
• Page copy: src/app/work/page.tsx
• Cards and filters: src/components/work-grid.tsx
• Footer and navigation words: src/components/site-shell.tsx

Design rules (same as the homepage)
• Forest #071C18, cream #EEE7DE, sand #E5DBD1, card #F6F1EA, copper #CF8649, copper text #8F5327
• Manrope for headings, Inter for text, square corners except the navigation pill and the filter pills
• 72px side margin on desktop, 20px on phones
